```lean
theorem lg_target (G : Type u) [CommGroup G] [Group.FG G] (hG : IsMulTorsion G) : Finite G := by
  haveI : IsTorsion G := IsMulTorsion.toIsTorsion hG
  haveI : TorsionGroup G := IsTorsion.toTorsionGroup this
  haveI : FiniteType G := TorsionGroup.toFiniteType this
  exact FiniteType.instFinite this
```
